card.name: Inside overdose and inadvertent wording
card.fires_on: The partial word 'overd' or 'inadvert' in overdose or inadvertent, plus nearby words about accidental intake or exposure, mostly in overdosage sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Overdose word start
modes.description: The 'overd' piece just before 'osage' in overdosage sections.
modes.example: There is limited experience of entecavir<< overd>>osage reported in patients.

modes.label: Inadvertent or accidental
modes.description: The word inadvertent or inadvertently describing unintended intake.
modes.example: when taken<< inadvertently>> during early pregnancy.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning accidental or unauthorized, such as accidental, accidentally and unauthorized.
card.plain: It marks spots in a label where an overdose or accidental exposure is being described.
